summary: Apollo Infrastructure Co LLC filed an 8-K under Items 3.02 and 8.01 reporting unregistered sales of equity securities to third-party investors for cash totaling approximately $40.50 million across multiple share types (Series I & II A-II, F-I, I shares), exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D/S. Separately, the registrant disclosed a net asset value per share for each class as of May 31, 2026 (ranging $28.15–$29.69) and announced a prospective change to a Transactional Net Asset Value methodology effective July 1, 2026, adjusting for fees, deferred taxes, and organizational expenses. The filing is a routine periodic NAV disclosure and private placement update, not a transformative special situation.
